attr.title: Odisea: El Arca Silenciosa
attr.desc: A third-person 3D platformer aboard the silent colony ark Odisea. Play as Elias, waking alone in the cryogenic crypt: climb, jump and ride moving platforms through the derelict dome, restore the coolant loop, and read the story in the wreckage instead of in cutscenes.
attr.inst: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.
